Earlier tests established that teleport destination depends on character size: large teleported to the blue pad, while small teleported to the pink pad.

4. I am still unsure of the complete projectile rule—particularly its range, collision behavior, and exact alignment requirements. I verified particular successful and failed shots, but those observations do not establish every position from which a switch can be activated. That leaves a gap in the model’s claim that no cheaper route exists.

VERDICT: undecided
CONFIDENCE: 95
